registrationFormText.thankYouText: Thank you for your interest in becoming a participating site of the Alzheimer’s Network for Treatment and Diagnostics (ALZ-NET).
registrationFormText.pleaseNoteText: Please note: Do not complete the form more than once for the same site location. If you have previously submitted a registration for this site, please contact the ALZ-NET team for assistance.
registrationFormText.instructionsText: Please complete the following questionnaire to register your site. Required fields are marked with an asterisk (*). After submission, the ALZ-NET team will review your information and contact you with next steps.

draftText: Your draft site registration form will be automatically deleted if there is 8 weeks of inactivity.
